evidence.reason: The trigger check treats every finding-quoted span that appears in `before` as a trigger: lines 484-501 fail if any such span survives in `after` or a cited dependency. It does not verify that the surviving span is the cited removed trigger; the later `supportedTrigger` check only requires that at least one quoted span was on a removed line. A finding that quotes a surviving name such as `load` alongside the actually removed `PARTIAL_MODE` can therefore produce a false `deleted-trigger-survives` failure after a correct patch. This is an implementation error in existing trigger-removed verification, not merely a proposal to add new scope.
